correctness.rationale: For R=|q|^2-L^2 and qdot=p, exact differentiation yields Rdot=2 q dot p, a necessary tangency condition for every trajectory on the sphere. At L=1/100 all three printed triples q=(0,0,1/100),(0,1/100,0),(1/100,0,0) and p=(11/1000,51/1000,51/1000) satisfy R=0, but their exact S=q dot p are 51/100000,51/100000,11/100000, all positive. Thus Rdot(0)>0: every such smooth trajectory immediately leaves the sphere. Independently checked rational values; the printed field defect equations Rdot=2S, Sdot=-R(q dot B+|p|^2)/L^2 agree with substitution and show invariant true constrained manifold. No numerical chaotic-dynamics inference is claimed.
